AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE - Led by the Boy Scout Troop #783
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR'S REPORT - MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1-9)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.
1.
APPROVAL OF WARRANTS
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council review and approve the June 10, 2025, Warrant Register.
Warrants
2.
RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR THE PERIOD ENDING APRIL 30, 2025.
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the financial statements for the month ending April 30, 2025.
Staff Report
3.
CITY COUNCIL MEETING ACTIONS
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the minutes for the Regular Council Meeting of May 27, 2025, and Special Council Meeting of June 2, 2025.
Minutes
4.
PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING ACTIONS
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the minutes for the Special Planning Commission Meeting of June 3, 2025.
Minutes
5.
PARKLANDS COMMITTEE MEETING ACTIONS
Recommendation: That the City Council approve the Parklands Committee Action Minutes for the following meeting: May 8, 2025.
Staff Report
Revised Staff Report
6.
INVESTMENT POLICY ADVISORY COMMITTEE MEETING ACTIONS
Recommendation: That the City Council approve the Investment Policy Advisory Committee Action Minutes for the following meeting: May 8, 2025.
Minutes
7.
APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT NO. 5 TO THE AGREEMENT FOR TREE TRIMMING AND MAINTENANCE SERVICES WITH TRAVERS TREE TRIMMING, INC. IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $364,000
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve Amendment No. 5 to the Agreement for citywide tree trimming and maintenance services with Travers Tree Service, Inc. (Travers) in an amount of $364,000, and extend the term of the agreement to June 30, 2026, with two (2) additional one-year periods. and authorize the City Manager to execute the Amendment.
Staff Report
8.
ADOPTION OF PROPOSED RESOLUTION R25-14, APPROVING THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES INVESTMENT POLICY FOR FISCAL YEARS 2024/2025 AND 2025/2026.
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt proposed Resolution R25-14 approving the City of Palos Verdes Estates Investment Policy for Fiscal Years 2024/2025 and 2025-2026.
Staff Report
9.
CONSIDER ADOPTION OF PROPOSED RESOLUTION R25-13 APPROVING THE SPECIAL TAX REPORT AND SETTING THE PALOS VERDES ESTATES LAW ENFORCEMENT SPECIAL TAX LEVY FOR FY 2025/2026 AND AUTHORIZING THE SENIOR ACCOUNTANT TO SUBMIT THE SPECIAL PARCEL TAX TO LOS ANGELES COUNTY
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt proposed Resolution R25-13, which approves the Special Tax Report and sets the Palos Verdes Estates Law Enforcement Special Tax (Special Parcel Tax) levy for Fiscal Year 2025-26, and the Senior Accountant to submit the Special Parcel Tax to Los Angeles County by the August 2025 deadline.
Staff Report
PUBLIC HEARING
10.
PALOS VERDES ESTATES 6TH CYCLE HOUSING ELEMENT 2021-2029 PROGRAM 13 REZONING PROJECT
Recommendation: 1. City Council open the public hearing, receive input, and introduce Ordinance No. 766 entitled:
AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES ADOPTING AN AMENDMENT TO THE ZONING CODE (ZTA-001-25) AND AN AMENDMENT TO THE OFFICIAL ZONING MAP (ZMA-001-25) FOR THE PALOS VERDES ESTATES 6TH CYCLE HOUSING ELEMENT 2021-2029 PROGRAM 13 REZONING PROJECT, AND ADOPTING AN INITIAL STUDY/MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION (IS-001-25) FOR THE PROJECT
2. City Council approve, by Resolution No. R25-11, a General Plan Amendment (GPA-001-25) for the Palos Verdes Estates 6th Cycle Housing Element 2021-2029 Program 13 Rezoning Project and adopt an Initial Study/Mitigated Negative Declaration (IS-001-25) for the project
Staff Report
